name: @examples/paypal-addon
description: Reusable internal package wrapping the PayPal SDK. It owns its own environment contract as a capability, independent of any application's feature folders -- see paypal-consumer for the application that consumes it, discovered across the real package boundary via ADR 0014's cross-package schema discovery (Experimental).

scripts.pack:local: npm run build && npm pack --pack-destination . && mv examples-paypal-addon-*.tgz paypal-addon.tgz
